source_methods.formal: Hampel9 threshold6 + PCHIP + SG31 derivative poly3 + clip0
source_methods.omit_oxygen_hampel: only omit statistical Hampel; retain physical invalid-value mask
source_methods.linear_oxygen_interpolation: only replace PCHIP interpolation by linear
source_methods.analytic_PCHIP_derivative: only replace SG by exact PCHIP derivative evaluated on the 0.5 s output grid
source_methods.secant_2s: only replace SG by centered 2 s cumulative secant, with one-sided endpoint widths
source_methods.omit_flow_clipping: only omit derivative clipping; diagnostic, negative flows preclude automatic formal adoption

gas_methods.acquisition_only: diagnostic, no cleaning; not a candidate

injection: M(background + analytic integral of flow pulse) and M(background) processed separately; gas uses M(background + gas pulse)
paired_unit: heat, signal, seed, event center; durations, doses, methods and hypotheses reuse that draw
known_nulls: constant true flow under hypothetical acquisition; post-acquisition known one-sample logging spikes
actual_background_truth: unknown; only added perturbations have known ground truth
